PowerShellfunction Test-HookIntegrity { Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue" $stateDir = Join-Path $root ".claude\run-state" $hashPath = Join-Path $stateDir "hook-hashes.json" $hookFiles = @( (Join-Path $root ".claude\hooks\stop-gate.ps1"), (Join-Path $root ".claude\hooks\posttool-recorder.ps1"), (Join-Path $root ".claude\hooks\block-dangerous.ps1") ) try { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stateDir -Force | Out-Null } $currentHashes = [ordered]@{} $missing = @() foreach ($hookPath in $hookFiles) { $name = Split-Path -Leaf $hookPath if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hookPath)) { $missing += $name continue } $currentHashes[$name] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $hookPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { return (Check "hook_integrity" $false ("FAIL missing: " + ($missing -join ", "))) } if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hashPath)) { [pscustomobject]@{ updated_at = (Get-Date).ToString("s") hooks = $currentHashes } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $hashPath -Encoding UTF8 return (Check "hook_integrity" $true "OK baseline created") } $baseline = Get-Content -LiteralPath $hashPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json $changed = @() foreach ($name in $currentHashes.Keys) { $oldHash = "" if ( $baseline.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "hooks" -and $null -ne $baseline.hooks -and $baseline.hooks.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $name ) { $oldHash = [string]$baseline.hooks.$name } if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($oldHash)) { $changed += "$name(new)" } elseif ($oldHash -ne $currentHashes[$name]) { $changed += $name } } [pscustomobject]@{ updated_at = (Get-Date).ToString("s") hooks = $currentHashes } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $hashPath -Encoding UTF8 if ($changed.Count -gt 0) { return (Check "hook_integrity" $true ("WARN hash changed: " + ($changed -join ", "))) } return (Check "hook_integrity" $true "OK hooks unchanged") } catch { return (Check "hook_integrity" $true ("WARN check failed-open: " + $_.Exception.Message)) }}# 集成:# $checks.Add((Test-HookIntegrity))
PowerShellfunction Test-PipelineDeep { Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue" $pipelineDir = Join-Path $root "ai-pipeline" $queueDir = Join-Path $pipelineDir "gpt-queue" $inboxDir = Join-Path $queueDir "inbox" $outboxDir = Join-Path $queueDir "outbox" $failedDir = Join-Path $queueDir "failed" try { foreach ($dir in @($queueDir, $inboxDir, $outboxDir, $failedDir)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null } } $probePath = Join-Path $queueDir ("health-probe-{0}.tmp" -f ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))) "ok" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $probePath -Encoding UTF8 $probeRead = Get-Content -LiteralPath $probePath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 Remove-Item -LiteralPath $probePath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($probeRead.Trim() -ne "ok") { return (Check "pipeline_deep" $false "FAIL queue read/write mismatch") } $inboxFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $inboxDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) $outboxFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $outboxDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) $failedFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $failedDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-30) $stale = @() foreach ($request in @($inboxFiles | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*.request.json" -and $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoff })) { $responseName = $request.Name -replace "\.request\.json$", ".response.json" $responsePath = Join-Path $outboxDir $responseName if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $responsePath)) { $stale += $request.Name } } $nodeCode = @"const { chromium } = require('playwright');(async () => { const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true }); await browser.close(); console.log('chromium_launch_ok');})().catch(err => { console.error(err && err.stack ? err.stack : String(err)); process.exit(1);});"@ try { Push-Location -LiteralPath $pipelineDir $browserOutput = @(& node -e $nodeCode 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) $browserExit = $LASTEXITCODE Pop-Location } catch { Pop-Location -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue return (Check "pipeline_deep" $false ("FAIL chromium launch exception: " + $_.Exception.Message)) } if ($null -eq $browserExit) { $browserExit = 0 } if ($browserExit -ne 0 -or (($browserOutput -join "`n") -notmatch "chromium_launch_ok")) { return (Check "pipeline_deep" $false ("FAIL chromium launch failed: " + (($browserOutput -join " ") -replace "\s+", " "))) } $detail = "OK queue rw; inbox=$($inboxFiles.Count) outbox=$($outboxFiles.Count) failed=$($failedFiles.Count); chromium launch ok" if ($stale.Count -gt 0) { $detail = "WARN stale=$($stale.Count); inbox=$($inboxFiles.Count) outbox=$($outboxFiles.Count) failed=$($failedFiles.Count); chromium launch ok; stale_files=" + ($stale -join ", ") } return (Check "pipeline_deep" $true $detail) } catch { return (Check "pipeline_deep" $false ("FAIL check error: " + $_.Exception.Message)) }}# 集成:# $checks.Add((Test-PipelineDeep))
